meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把单个文档交给 NotebookLM 做成卡哇伊风格的幻灯片 PDF，并存成文件；若配置了分享服务，还会返回手机版分享链接。源文档缺失或太单薄时，会先自动撰写长文稿再生成。只做幻灯片，不做视频/播客。
howto.when: 当你说“wowerpoint 这个”“把这份报告做成幻灯片”或“make a deck about <文件>”等，即要求把单个文档变成可分享的叙述型幻灯片时触发。

say.text: 把这份会议纪要做成幻灯片
say.note: 会调用技能产出幻灯片 PDF。

say.text: 给这篇研究报告做一个卡哇伊风格幻灯片
say.note: 触发 wowerpoint，生成叙述型幻灯片。

howto.what_en: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF saved as a file, with a mobile share link when configured. Writes a long-form source first if input is missing or thin. Slide decks only — no videos or podcasts.
howto.when_en: When the user says 'wowerpoint this', 'make a deck about <file>', 'turn this report into slides', or otherwise asks to render one document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.note: Produces a slide-deck PDF from the report, plus a share link if configured.

say_en.text: Turn these meeting notes into slides
say_en.note: Runs wowerpoint to generate a slide deck.

say_en.text: Make a kawaii deck from this research paper
say_en.note: Starts the wowerpoint slide-deck workflow for that document.
